scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:functions
scripts.build:functions: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('netlify/functions', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild netlify/functions-src/api.mjs netlify/functions-src/blob.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outdir=netlify/functions --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:pg --external:@netlify/blobs --external:@netlify/database --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/test netlify/functions-src
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
